INSERT INTO rag_vectors (chunk_id, doc_id, project_id, embedding_model, embedding_dimension, embedding, created_at) VALUES
(#{item.chunkId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.docId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.projectId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.embeddingModel,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.embeddingDimension,jdbcType=INTEGER}, CAST(#{item.embedding,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS vector), #{item.createdAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP})
ON CONFLICT (chunk_id) DO UPDATE SET doc_id = EXCLUDED.doc_id, project_id = EXCLUDED.project_id, embedding_model = EXCLUDED.embedding_model, embedding_dimension = EXCLUDED.embedding_dimension, embedding = EXCLUDED.embedding, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at
